title: Compose client middleware
excerpt: Compose client middleware A middleware wraps the fetch a client transport uses, so it sees every HTTP request on the way out and every Response on the way back. Write a middleware createMiddleware builds one from a function that receives the next handler plus the request. Compose it onto fetch with applyMiddlewares and hand the result to the transport's fetch option.
